title: Wyrm Emerging from Eggs
description: A large pale green serpentine dragon with orange eyes and intricate scales rises from a cracked volcanic desert ground. Multiple golden eggs with glowing purple cracks are scattered around it, some broken, as lava flows through fissures beneath a dramatic fiery sky.
prompt: A massive pale green serpentine dragon with detailed scales, horns, and glowing orange eyes rises from cracked earth in a volcanic desert wasteland. Several ornate golden eggs with glowing purple crystalline cracks are scattered around the creature, some shattered. Rivers of lava flow through fissures in the ground under a dramatic orange and purple cloudy sky at dusk, epic fantasy scene, highly detailed digital painting.
